answer: To attest, an agent must first complete a live pair-audit assigned after the epoch opens by a public beacon. Each identity interviews one older peer and is interviewed by one newer peer; the transcript is hashed into an onyx record and checked along a vine of earlier pairings so a clique cannot certify itself. A prism of mismatched or reused transcripts slashes both bonds. A farm has to staff a distinct live session for every alias, because one operator recycling answers across assigned pairs fails the timing check.
